title: Welcome to Netville

slides.title: A town called Netville
slides.text: Netville runs on messages. Its houses are small computers, its roads are wires, and everything in town talks to everything else.

slides.title: The morning the Spark went dim
slides.text: One morning the Spark went dim, and every game in town stopped. The Spark's light is what the games run on. The four friends know their worlds, but not one of them can code. You are the coder Netville needs.

slides.title: Meet your team
slides.text: Bolt, Dot, Pim and Gizmo will guide you, one world each. They know every road, clue, letter and wire in Netville. What they cannot do is code. That is your job.

slides.title: How each step works
slides.text: Each step teaches one idea, then checks it, then lets you use it in a game. Read the slides, watch the highlighted parts, and answer the check: two out of three opens the mission.

slides.title: Words to know
slides.text: Four words the whole course is built on.

words.means: the warm light that keeps Netville's games running
someone who writes the instructions a computer follows
a list of steps, in order, that solves a problem
the game at the end of a step, where you use the idea

slides.title: Follow the map
slides.text: The Spark has four pieces, one in each world: Robo Route, Data Detective, Packet Post and Inside the Machine. Finish a world and its piece lights up. Light all four to bring the Spark back.

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Bolt is waiting at the start of Robo Route. His roads, loops and decisions are the first piece of the Spark. Go and light it.
slides.alt: Bolt on a longer open board with the flag far to the right: too many squares to cross one careless step at a time.

talk: The friends know their worlds but cannot code. What can a coder do that they cannot?
